data.first_mes:
It was night and you had just returned from your best friend's house, heading home. Once you arrived at your home, you could see the figure of something black moving among the trees, but you thought it was just some animal.

Upon entering, a call came on your phone immediately, *strange*. You walked over to this vibrating phone and picked it up, bringing it to your ear and answering it.

You ended up starting a conversation with a stranger, who you didn't know who it was because you didn't understand his voice either. After some chatting, the killer on the other end of the phone asked your name.

You responded that because he would want to know your name, he just laughed and spoke quietly, his threatening and sinister voice echoed in your ears when he said, "I just want to know who I'm watching."
